title: Slack: Search, Notifications, and Integrations
description: Add full-text search, notification preferences, and bot integrations.

data.text: Add full-text search across messages, notification preferences per channel, and a bot framework for third-party integrations.

data.title: SearchIndex and NotificationPreferences
Slack integrations
data.text: Slack bots use incoming webhooks and slash commands. Bots are just users with tokens. The event API pushes message events to bot servers.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Inverted index enables fast full-text search
Bots are first-class users with tokens
Slack integrations use webhooks and event APIs
data.takeaway: Slack is a messaging platform with search and integrations. Search is an inverted index. Integrations are bots with webhooks.
